title: The Messy Reality of ‘Made in America’

sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: The construction of a massive factory in Arizona was supposed to embody the Trump administration's ability to bring manufacturing back to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州一座大型工厂的建设，本应体现特朗普政府将制造业带回美国的能力。

sentences.en: Instead, as my colleague Peter Goodman found out, it's provided companies around the world with literally 18,000 reasons to think twice about building in America.
sentences.zh: 然而，正如我的同事彼得·古德曼所发现的那样，它反而给世界各地的公司提供了整整18,000个理由，让他们在考虑是否要在美国建厂时三思而后行。

sentences.en: It's Monday, December 22nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月22日，星期一。

sentences.en: Peter, good of you to come to the studio.
sentences.zh: 彼得，你能来演播室真是太好了。

sentences.en: Delighted.
sentences.zh: 非常荣幸。

sentences.en: I wonder, just to start this conversation, if you can describe this factory that you recently visited to us.
sentences.zh: 我想，在谈话开始时，你能否为我们描述一下你最近参观的那座工厂？

sentences.en: Yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: So it's about 9.20 in the morning on Friday, and I'm just arriving.
sentences.zh: 那是周五早上9点20分左右，我刚到那里。

sentences.en: I mean, there's this giant, mostly empty desert valley in the extreme north of Phoenix, as far as the eye can see, really.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在凤凰城的最北端，有一片巨大的、几乎空无一人的沙漠山谷，一眼望不到头，真的。

sentences.en: Emptiness.
sentences.zh: 空旷。

sentences.en: I'm standing on a gravel road, looking at cactuses and various desert scrub just flowing out to the horizons, that this is all going to get filled up with housing and offices.
sentences.zh: 我站在一条碎石路上，看着仙人掌和各种沙漠灌木一直延伸到地平线，而这一切都将被住房和办公室填满。

sentences.en: So this factory, I've seen a lot of factories in my day.
sentences.zh: 所以这座工厂，我这辈子见过很多工厂。

sentences.en: You sure have.
sentences.zh: 你确实见过。

sentences.en: Is on a scale that I've never even imagined.
sentences.zh: 它的规模是我从未想象过的。

sentences.en: We're talking about more than 1,000 acres.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是超过1,000英亩的土地。

sentences.en: The complex itself, I'm looking at a long, low, gray building with a bunch of smokestacks visible on top.
sentences.zh: 至于建筑群本身，我看到的是一栋长长的、低矮的灰色建筑，顶部可以看到一排排烟囱。

sentences.en: You can see at least a dozen cranes.
sentences.zh: 你能看到至少十几台起重机。

sentences.en: You can hear the roar of something.
sentences.zh: 你能听到某种轰鸣声。

sentences.en: There's black smoke now coming out of the top of one of these buildings.
sentences.zh: 现在其中一栋建筑的顶部正冒出黑烟。

sentences.en: And beyond, you can see these cranes that are working.
sentences.zh: 而在远处，你可以看到那些正在作业的起重机。

sentences.en: And there are construction cranes in every direction.
sentences.zh: 四面八方都是建筑起重机。

sentences.en: Now, I lived in Shanghai, China, in the height of the construction boom there.
sentences.zh: 我曾经在中国上海住过，当时正值那里的建筑热潮。

sentences.en: So I was in Dubai when Dubai was under enormous construction.
sentences.zh: 我也去过迪拜，当时迪拜正在进行大规模建设。

sentences.en: And then to the west of there, there's a ton of cranes just counting real.
sentences.zh: 而在那里的西边，有成吨的起重机，真的数不过来。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm running out.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我快数不过来了。

sentences.en: I've counted 15 of them, and there's still more.
sentences.zh: 我已经数了15台，而且还有更多。

sentences.en: And then there's more visible, like, way beyond to the weSt.
sentences.zh: 而且在更远处的西边还能看到更多。

sentences.en: These are the only places where I've seen these numbers of cranes and numbers of construction people wandering about.
sentences.zh: 这些是我见过如此多起重机和建筑工人四处走动的地方。

sentences.en: And that feeling of, like, you're present there for a moment when things are really changing in a deep way in that place.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉就像，你身处其中，亲眼见证了这个地方正在发生深刻的变化。

sentences.en: Just beyond, I see heavy equipment on the move.
sentences.zh: 就在前方，我看到重型设备在移动。

sentences.en: I see diggers that are moving soil around.
sentences.zh: 我看到挖掘机在搬运泥土。

sentences.en: There's a whole wall of porta-potties, as you would expect at a giant construction project.
sentences.zh: 正如你在大型建筑工地上所预料的那样，有一整排移动厕所。

sentences.en: I mean, this is, people say, the biggest construction project in North America.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，人们说这是北美最大的建筑工程。

sentences.en: And I got to say, it doesn't disappoint.
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，它确实名不虚传。

sentences.en: And looking at this factory under construction evokes that sense as well.
sentences.zh: 看着这座正在建设中的工厂，也唤起了那种感觉。

sentences.en: Of scale.
sentences.zh: 关于规模的感觉。

sentences.en: Not just scale, but that this is important beyond the thing itself.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是规模，而是这件事情本身意义重大。

sentences.en: What does it represent, this gargantuan, crane-filled factory-ville?
sentences.zh: 这座巨大的、布满起重机的“工厂之城”代表了什么？

sentences.en: It represents a moment when a consensus broke out in the American political system, in the business world, that globalization,
sentences.zh: 它代表了一个时刻，当时美国政治体系和商业界达成了一种共识，即全球化，

sentences.en: this system that we've been living under for most of our adult lives, has been very fruitful and beneficial in all sorts of ways, but there are some things
sentences.zh: 这个我们成年后大部分时间都生活在其中的体系，在各方面都非常有成效且有益，但有些事情

sentences.en: where it matters where we make them.
sentences.zh: 我们必须考虑在哪里生产它们。

sentences.en: And one of those things is computer chips.
sentences.zh: 其中之一就是电脑芯片。

sentences.en: We need to have our own stock of computer chips.
sentences.zh: 我们需要拥有自己的电脑芯片储备。

sentences.en: We need to make them at home in the event of war or disaster.
sentences.zh: 在战争或灾难发生时，我们需要在本土生产它们。

sentences.en: And that's what they're making in these factories that I saw.
sentences.zh: 而这正是他们在我看到的这些工厂里所做的事情。

sentences.en: Computer chips are the brains of just about everything.
sentences.zh: 电脑芯片几乎是所有东西的大脑。

sentences.en: The iPhone in your hand, the data centers that are getting built all over the place to make artificial intelligence work.
sentences.zh: 你手中的iPhone，以及为了让人工智能运行而到处建立的数据中心。

sentences.en: They're going into our cars.
sentences.zh: 它们正进入我们的汽车。

sentences.en: They're going into our appliances.
sentences.zh: 它们正进入我们的家用电器。

sentences.en: I mean, it's pretty hard to think about any manufactured product now that doesn't have some kind of computer chip.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，现在很难想到任何没有某种电脑芯片的制造产品。

sentences.en: So it would seem like a very, very big and overdue thing to have such a factory building those chips right here in America.
sentences.zh: 所以，在美国本土建立这样一家生产芯片的工厂，似乎是一件非常、非常重要且早该做的事情。

sentences.en: It's a big deal.
sentences.zh: 这是一件大事。

sentences.en: I mean, it is the most palpable manifestation of this really, I think you can say, national aspiration to build things in America again.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是我认为可以称之为“再次在美国制造”这一国家愿望的最明显的体现。

sentences.en: But there are some complications.
sentences.zh: 但也有一些复杂的情况。

sentences.en: This company that's building these factories is not American.
sentences.zh: 建造这些工厂的公司不是美国公司。

sentences.en: It's Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Corps,
sentences.zh: 它是台湾积体电路制造公司，

sentences.en: TSMC as it's known.
sentences.zh: 也就是众所周知的台积电。

sentences.en: It is a Taiwanese company.
sentences.zh: 这是一家台湾公司。

sentences.en: It is a very successful Taiwanese company.
sentences.zh: 这是一家非常成功的台湾公司。

sentences.en: But it's also been an excruciating pain for TSMC to get this thing built with American subsidies, with a whole political process designed to bring this about.
sentences.zh: 但对于台积电来说，在获得美国补贴以及整个旨在实现这一目标的政治进程下，把这个项目建起来也是极其痛苦的。

sentences.en: It's still been slow, expensive, and difficult.
sentences.zh: 它仍然进展缓慢、成本高昂且困难重重。

sentences.en: And so it really raises the question, is this a triumph?
sentences.zh: 所以这确实引发了一个问题：这算是一次胜利吗？

sentences.en: Is this the template for how we can do this going forward?
sentences.zh: 这是我们未来可以效仿的模板吗？

sentences.en: Or is this the cautionary tale?
sentences.zh: 还是说这是一个警示故事？

sentences.en: So, Peter, tell us the story of this factory and all the ways in which it suggests a potential future or perhaps the impracticality of that future.
sentences.zh: 那么，彼得，请给我们讲讲这座工厂的故事，以及它在哪些方面暗示了一个潜在的未来，或者说暗示了那个未来的不切实际。

sentences.en: Look, you have to go back to the pandemic, which was the great reveal that it's not such a great idea to concentrate nearly all of the production
sentences.zh: 听着，你必须回到疫情时期，那是一次重大的揭示，即把几乎所有重要产品的生产集中在单一国家并不是一个好主意。

sentences.en: of vital things in single countries.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，醒来后发现，除非你从中国进口，否则在疫情期间你根本无法制造呼吸机。

sentences.en: So, you know, waking up and discovering that you really can't make a ventilator in the middle of a pandemic unless you import stuff from China.
sentences.zh: 而当时疫情最严重的地方。

sentences.en: Where the pandemic was at its worSt.
sentences.zh: 疫情开始的地方，一个我们不经意间决定与其进行贸易战的国家，这并不是可靠获取所需物资的好方法。

sentences.en: Where the pandemic began, a country that not incidentally we decided to have a trade war with, not a great way to reliably get the stuff you need.
sentences.zh: 而电脑芯片，最先进的那些，绝大多数是在台湾制造的。

sentences.en: And computer chips, the most advanced ones, are made overwhelmingly in Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 台湾当然是一个自治岛屿，被中华人民共和国及其北京政府声称为中国领土的一部分，

sentences.en: Taiwan is, of course, a self-governing island that is claimed as part of Chinese territory by the People's Republic of China and its government in Beijing,
sentences.zh: 这意味着，你知道，中国军队在任何一天出现并接管该地区的风险并非为零。

sentences.en: which means that, you know, there is the not zero risk that on any given day the Chinese military could show up and take over.
sentences.zh: 那可能会对电脑芯片造成巨大的破坏。

sentences.en: And that could be an enormous disruption to the computer chips.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，疫情是对如果中国突然入侵台湾会发生什么的一种理论上的预演，因为它向我们展示了当全球供应链被切断时会是什么样子。

sentences.en: And in a sense, the pandemic was a potential theoretical foretaste of what it would be like if all of a sudden China were to invade Taiwan because it showed us what it looks like
sentences.zh: 突然之间，我们不得不面对这样一个想法：也许所有那些电脑芯片永远无法离开台湾。

sentences.en: when your global supply chains get cut off.
sentences.zh: 我们必须考虑韧性。

sentences.en: Suddenly, we have to grapple with the idea that maybe all those computer chips can never get out of Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 我们需要，可以这样想，我们需要一些保险。

sentences.en: And we have to think about resilience.
sentences.zh: 并不是说全球化不好。

sentences.en: We need, the way to think of it is we need some insurance.
sentences.zh: 而是没有针对风险（这是生活中不可避免的一部分）进行保险的全球化，

sentences.en: It's not that globalization is bad.
sentences.zh: 那就不太好了。

sentences.en: It's the globalization without insurance against the risks that are an inevitable part of life.
sentences.zh: 那么这种保险实际上是什么样子的呢？

sentences.en: That's not so good.
sentences.zh: 它看起来就像政府说，我们必须在确保某些东西在美国制造方面发挥直接作用。

sentences.en: And what does that insurance actually look like?
sentences.zh: 这需要补贴。

sentences.en: It looks like the government saying we're going to have to play a direct role in making sure that certain things are built in the United States.
sentences.zh: 于是拜登政府上台了。

sentences.en: And that's going to require subsidies.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府打破了数代以来的自由贸易教条，即我们只让市场来决定什么东西在哪里制造。

sentences.en: So along comes the Biden administration.
sentences.zh: 他们说，效率只能带我们走到这一步。

sentences.en: And the Biden administration breaks from generations of free trade dogma, this idea that we just let the market sort out what gets built and where.
sentences.zh: 政府必须发挥作用，确保像电脑芯片这样的特定产品在美国制造。

sentences.en: And they say, efficiency only takes us so far.
sentences.zh: 这就是《芯片与科学法案》，这是一项具有里程碑意义的立法，向在美国建造电脑芯片工厂的公司提供了数百亿美元的补贴，其中一家公司，

sentences.en: The government's going to have to play a role in making sure that certain things like computer chips are built in the United States.
sentences.zh: 台湾积体电路制造公司，实际上参与了这项法案的起草。

sentences.en: And this becomes the Chips and Science Act, this landmark piece of legislation that's got tens of billions of dollars in subsidies given to companies
sentences.zh: 而那家公司，

sentences.en: that build computer chip factories in the United States, one of those companies,
sentences.zh: 台积电，最终获得了60多亿美元的拨款，用于在凤凰城建造这个工厂群。

sentences.en: Taiwan Semiconductor, actually participates in the writing of this bill.
sentences.zh: 最终，当一切建成后，他们将在凤凰城生产他们全球所有先进芯片中大约三分之一的产量。

sentences.en: And that company,
sentences.zh: 考虑到之前有多少工作集中在台湾，这是一件非常、非常大的事情。

sentences.en: TSMC, ends up with a $6 billion plus grant to then build this complex of factories in Phoenix.
sentences.zh: 这是一件大事。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, when it's all built, they'll be making roughly a third of all the advanced chips they make worldwide right there in Phoenix, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 这对台积电来说是一件大事。

sentences.en: That's a really, really big deal given just how much of that work was concentrated in Taiwan.
sentences.zh: 这对美国来说是一件大事。

sentences.en: It's a very big deal.
sentences.zh: 对于凤凰城的当地经济来说，这当然也是一件大事，因为当地经济传统上与房地产的繁荣与萧条周期紧密相连。

sentences.en: It's a very big deal for TSMC.
sentences.zh: 现在我们谈论的是成千上万的建筑工作岗位来建造它，还有成千上万的工作岗位来最终制造芯片本身。

sentences.en: It's a very big deal for the United States.
sentences.zh: 还有各种各样的，你知道，相关服务，律师、保险公司、餐饮承办商、卡车司机、仓库。

sentences.en: And it's certainly a very big deal for the local economy in Phoenix, which has traditionally been very tied to the boom and bust cycle of real estate.
sentences.zh: 理论上，任何一个州都会为了这种经济活动而拼命。

sentences.en: And now we're talking about thousands of jobs in construction to build this, thousands more to eventually make the chips themselves.
sentences.zh: 任何一个州都会为了这种经济活动而拼命。

sentences.en: And then there's all sorts of, you know, associated services, lawyers, insurance companies, caterers, truck drivers, warehouses.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: a state would in theory kill for this kind of economic activity.
sentences.zh: 所以在奠基那天，那是2022年12月，

sentences.en: Any state would kill for this kind of economic activity.
sentences.zh: 你有亚利桑那州的共和党州长，有参议院成员，有工会代表，有大学校长。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我告诉你，你从正确的地方开始了。

sentences.en: So on the day of the groundbreaking, this is December 2022,
sentences.zh: 这将成为亚利桑那州的一项不可思议的资产。

sentences.en: you've got the Republican governor of the state of Arizona, you've got members of the Senate, you have union representatives, university presidents.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢你们。

sentences.en: Well, I tell you what, you're starting off in the right place.
sentences.zh: 最后，

sentences.en: This is going to be an incredible asset to the state of Arizona.
sentences.zh: 民主党总统乔·拜登出现了，他带头庆祝这一经济发展的巨大胜利。

sentences.en: A special thanks to you.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢你。

sentences.en: And finally,
sentences.zh: 你我立场不同，但我们看到了并分享着同样的愿景，即亚利桑那州作为一个中心，一个名副其实的技术中心，将发生技术变革。

sentences.en: Joe Biden, the Democratic president, shows up leading the parade in celebration of this enormous triumph in economic development.
sentences.zh: 而这已经在……
总统正在将他的政府与重塑未来联系起来。

sentences.en: You and I are different sides, but we see and share the same vision as Arizona's a hub, literally a hub for tech, for technical change that's going to take place.
sentences.zh: 我知道，我们的主持人不会介意我指出是美国发明了芯片。

sentences.en: And that's well under...
sentences.zh: 他很高兴谈论这对美国制造业的复兴有多么重要，而且这是一件具有前瞻性的事情。

sentences.en: The president president is associating his administration with reclaiming the future.
sentences.zh: 这是在建设一个美国未来，涉及的是美国实际上开创的技术。

sentences.en: And I know, our host won't mind my pointing out that America invented the chip.
sentences.zh: 你们在这里是因为你们看到了我们所有人都在看到的东西。

sentences.en: He's delighted to be talking about what a huge deal this is for the rejuvenation of American manufacturing and in something that's, you know, forward-looking.
sentences.zh: 美国制造业回来了，伙计们。

sentences.en: This is building an American future in a technology that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国制造业回来了。

sentences.en: actually pioneered.
sentences.zh: 我知道，因为你在我们谈话开始时就说了，

sentences.en: And you're here because you're seeing what we're all seeing.
sentences.zh: 彼得，这个故事即将出现一个复杂的转折。

sentences.en: America manufacturing is back, folks.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，确实值得一说的是，这是一个关于美国体系可能性的寓言，而这个体系并不以完成任何大型国内制造业项目而闻名。

sentences.en: America manufacturing is back.
sentences.zh: 是的。
